description: This file defines a Page Object Model representation of the login page in the OrangeHRM application. It contains methods to open the login page, perform login with provided credentials, resolve credential placeholders, and check for validation messages.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Page object representing the login page of OrangeHRM, providing methods to interact with the login form and validate login-related messages.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Navigates to the login page URL.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with specified username and password, resolving placeholders if any.

methods.name: resolveCredentialPlaceholder
methods.description: Resolves placeholders like __ADMIN_USERNAME__ to actual credential values from TestConfig.

methods.name: isInvalidCredentialsShown
methods.description: Checks if the invalid credentials toast message is present.

methods.name: isRequiredShown
methods.description: Checks if the required field message is displayed.
